authority: Declaration of what must be tracked, what may be present untracked, and what may be present ignored. Verified against real git state by scripts/check-inventory.cjs; it is not a self-report.
why: A broad .gitignore pattern can hide a file that must travel with the repository, so the loss is invisible to `git status` and to any review that counts status lines. This declaration makes that ignore surface explicit and checkable.
notes: must_track_globs are files that MUST travel: every path matching them that is present on disk has to be tracked. vendor/*.tgz is the offline dependency graph a clean clone installs from; retired/**/*.tgz is the byte-preservation archive surface-disposition.json declares as still present under retired/.
A must-track glob may be added but the two required ones cannot be removed; scripts/check-inventory.cjs holds them as hard invariants of its own.

allowed_untracked_globs and allowed_ignored_globs are the reviewed exception list. Anything present but untracked or ignored that is not listed here is a failure, because it means the ignore surface changed without a declaration.
packed-files.json and aikdna-kdna-cli-*.tgz are local build outputs of `npm pack`; they exist only while a pack report is being produced and are never repository content.
tracked_count is the exact number of tracked files. Re-pin it in the same change that adds or removes tracked files; the gate prints the command in its failure message.

Eleven exact companion inputs support current native development. The delivery generator packs this CLI and emits an independent twelve-archive consumer with its own lock; earlier vendor archives remain historical.
